title: DisclosureDecision
description: Result of DisclosureGate.decide(card, target) (ADR-0012). Default deny: without a matching allow rule the decision is deny. An allow for cloud_model is only valid with the user's per-transfer confirmation. Stance data is allowed for target screen only. Decisions are logged without card content.

ruleId.description: Id of the rule that decided: the matching deny rule, or else the matching allow rule. Absent for default deny.

confirmationRequired.description: True when the decision is deny only because the per-transfer confirmation is missing.

allOf.description: cloud_model requires a per-transfer confirmation for every allow.
Confirmations exist only for cloud_model transfers.
Stance data never leaves the screen (ADR-0008).

subject.title: DisclosureSubject
subject.description: What is being disclosed: a card, or the user's stance data on a card.

transfer.title: DisclosureTransfer
transfer.description: A previewed cloud_model transfer awaiting the user's confirmation (ADR-0012, ADR-0031). The record lives in memory on the service, expires 5 minutes after the preview, and is void after a restart. `cardIds` lists the ids of the objects in the envelope; `payloadHash` must be echoed by the confirmation.

requestedBy.description: Who will send: the board session (token flow) or a registered MCP connection (released to that connection only).

confirmRequest.title: DisclosureConfirmRequest
confirmRequest.description: Body of the human-only confirm operation (the transferId is in the path). The service rejects a payloadHash that differs from the stored one or from the hash of the current envelope, and a second confirmation (409), and an expired transfer (410).

confirmation.title: DisclosureConfirmation
confirmation.description: Response of the human-only confirm operation (ADR-0031, ADR-0028). For a transfer the board previewed for its own send, it carries a single-use token (at least 128 random bits, held server side, bound to the confirming human session, valid 5 minutes, void after a restart) that the send call carries; the service consumes it atomically before sending. For a transfer an MCP connection registered as cloud_model asked for, there is no token: the agent re-calls with the transferId and the service releases the content to that connection only. Never logged.

payloadHash.title: PayloadHash
payloadHash.description: sha256:<lower-case hex> over the RFC 8785 (JCS) serialisation of the preview envelope (ADR-0031, ADR-0034).

modelRequest.title: DisclosureModelRequest
modelRequest.description: The request parameters that go to the model with the objects.

outputSchema.description: JSON Schema the answer must follow (level 1).

previewEnvelope.title: DisclosurePreviewEnvelope
previewEnvelope.description: Exactly what would leave the device: the target, the connector, the request parameters and the canonical objects after the gate decision. The payload hash covers this envelope.

previewRequest.title: DisclosurePreviewRequest
previewRequest.description: Body of the human-only preview operation: what the user wants to send. The server builds the envelope from gate-cleared canonical objects only.

confirmationToken.title: ConfirmationToken
confirmationToken.description: Opaque single-use token, base64url of at least 16 random bytes (128 bits).

confirmationRef.title: DisclosureConfirmationRef
confirmationRef.description: Reference to a confirmed transfer whose token was consumed for this send; recorded in gate decisions and context packages. Contains no token.

denied.title: DeniedCard
denied.description: A card the gate withheld from this response, with the reason; never its content.

release.title: DisclosureRelease
release.description: Result of consuming a confirmation for one send (DisclosureGate.redeem): exactly the canonical objects the human confirmed, nothing else. Cloud content leaves the device only as these objects.

shareBundle.title: ShareBundle
shareBundle.description: Result of DisclosureGate.prepareShare (ADR-0036): the share projections of the cards allowed for target share, and the ids and reasons of the others. Never stance data, never a conclusion. A later sharing slice adds a hash-bound confirmation before anything is sent.
